Menus now ease open and shut on one shared motion layer. It shipped as v29.60 and v29.62, and both passed the gate (seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged).

- **v29.60:** the layer is on the title menu, the party window and the arcade board pages. It has:
  - 240 ms open with a 16 px rise and 140 ms close
  - items staggered 35 ms apart (max 8)
  - a 200 ms tab slide
  - an eased focus ring and a 1.05 focused cell
  - a confirm pulse and a deny shake
  - presses mid-move retarget from the current value
  - one sound per event kind: a focus tick with four pitches, capped at one per 40 ms, plus confirm, back and deny
- **v29.62:** the pause card, end card, Settings and Keys now use the same layer. The end card plays no open or close sound, so it doesn't clash with the extraction sting. The Keys window is built on first use, so it joins the layer when it is created.
- **Checks:** all measure time on a steppable clock, not pictures. They cover open at 0/50/100/200 ms, stagger gaps, close under 150 ms, and a press or close mid-transition handled within one frame. They also cover pulse and shake, tab slide, ring progress at 16/66/120 ms, exactly one tick per focus change, and the sound picker. A new check covers the four newly added screens.
- **Not done:**
  - the 4K frame-time measurement
  - hover ring
  - backdrop drift
  - cursor parallax
  - glimmer sweep

  Other `.modal` windows, like the trader and stash, can join by adding their ids to the motion scope and watch list. Notes are in `notes/11b-ui-motion.md` and the change is logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: 4K frame-time measure, hover ring, backdrop drift, cursor parallax and glimmer remain; other modals can be added to the layer the same way.
